description: Individual entries for five Windweaver Fern varieties.

entries.title: Silverveil Fern
entries.summary: Reflective high-wind fronds yield camouflage cloth, light-deflecting garments, and wind-resistant sails.
body: Released spores generate sharp gusts useful for propulsion and defense. Reflection attracts aerial predators, while inhalation can produce temporary blindness and light sensitivity.

entries.title: Shadowlace Fern
entries.summary: A moonlit crevice fern produces stealth dye, fine armor silk, and concealing shadow fog.
body: Deep blue fronds thrive under islands. The released fog enables escape and ambush but causes vertigo and confusion, while nocturnal predators often nest near the plant.

entries.title: Stormtide Fern
entries.summary: A conductive storm-edge fern supports surge-resistant equipment and wind-and-lightning enchantment.
body: Teal fronds marked like lightning release static spores that repel small predators. Harvest during storms can amplify electrical activity, shock workers, and damage nearby systems.

entries.title: Glowglide Fern
entries.summary: A soothing luminous fern provides lasting light-fiber and calming spores for animals and tense communities.
body: Golden-tipped fronds illuminate lanterns, garments, and settlements. Its pheromones reduce aggression but can cause lethargy, while the glow attracts insects and small predators in large numbers.

entries.title: Hearthfern
entries.summary: A warm-veined fern supplies fire-resistant cloth, heatproof sails, and cold-defying tonic.
body: Temperate islands and ruins support the deep green plant. Its spores repel frost predators with heat, but may summon fire elementals, ignite volatile goods, or scorch harvesters during bloom.
